// OSINT OPEN ACCESS RESEARCH

> BLOCKCHAIN EXPLORERS

MATCHING RECORDS: 15

  • Etherscan:
    Free, unauthenticated block explorer for inspecting transactions, smart contract code, and ERC token movements on the Ethereum network.
  • Blockchair:
    Multi-chain search engine allowing unauthenticated address, block, and transaction queries across dozens of networks with a strong privacy stance.
  • Blockstream Explorer:
    Open-source, zero-telemetry Bitcoin and Liquid network explorer built on the Esplora engine, requiring no account registration.
  • Mempool.space:
    Open-source, AGPL-licensed Bitcoin mempool visualizer and chain explorer focusing on real-time fee markets, self-hostable with zero user tracking.
  • Ethplorer:
    Free web utility for examining Ethereum address token balances, ERC-20 transaction histories, and transfer volumes without signups.
  • BitInfoCharts:
    Free multi-cryptocurrency analytics engine and rich-list directory providing raw chain statistics and address distributions without account locks.
  • BSCScan:
    Free, unauthenticated network explorer for querying transactions, smart contracts, and token analytics on the BNB Smart Chain.
  • Polygonscan:
    Free web explorer for querying wallet balances, transaction hashes, and smart contract verification on the Polygon network.
  • Arbiscan:
    Free, unauthenticated block explorer for tracing transactions, smart contracts, and wallet balances on Arbitrum networks.
  • Tronscan:
    Official network explorer allowing direct unauthenticated tracking of TRC-20 token transfers and TRON smart contracts.
  • Solscan:
    Free web explorer for querying Solana account balances, SPL token transfers, and transaction execution details.
  • Solana Explorer:
    Official, non-paywalled block explorer maintained by the Solana Foundation for inspecting cluster activity and wallet state.
  • CardanoScan:
    Free web utility permitting unauthenticated queries for ADA transactions, stake pool metrics, and native Cardano tokens.
  • XRPSCAN:
    Open-access explorer for analyzing payment paths, trustlines, and wallet balances across the XRP Ledger.
  • OXT:
    Advanced Bitcoin visual analysis platform offering free UTXO flow mapping, transaction clustering, and network privacy metrics without signups.
